settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Omaha Beach 6 June 1944, eye-level soldier POV, wet landing gear, gray dawn, sea spray, smoke, subdued documentary color, authentic 1944 equipment and terrain, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD, no heroic glamour. Prioritize tactile realism, believable human movement, environmental depth and quiet observation between bursts of danger.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite U.S. infantry soldier POV inside the real Omaha Beach assault. One scene equals one primary action and one camera movement. No spoken dialogue. No narration. No intelligible human speech. Do not make every scene a firefight. Build a realistic rhythm of danger, movement, waiting, exhaustion, observation and recovery. At least several scenes should be quiet or nearly quiet, with breathing and environmental detail carrying the experience. Audio uses only breathing, nonverbal exertion, environmental ambience, equipment movement and historically plausible battlefield sound effects.
settings.customVisualStyle: Grounded photorealistic WWII first-person cinematic reenactment, handheld eye-level movement, natural overcast light, realistic sea spray, smoke and dust, non-graphic. Camera behaves like a tired human body with weight, hesitation, imperfect balance, short stillness and natural head movement. Preserve wet clothing, mud, sand, fatigue and gear continuity across scenes.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP01 — D-Day: Omaha Beach
movie.storySummary: A fictional composite U.S. infantry soldier experiences the opening assault on Omaha Beach on 6 June 1944, from the landing craft through the exposed beach and up toward the bluffs, ending with a fragile foothold inland.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of one fictional composite American infantry soldier during the D-Day assault on Omaha Beach. Historically grounded, respectful, non-graphic, and physically immersive. The viewer should feel cold seawater inside boots, wet fabric against skin, the weight of the rifle, sand on gloves, sea wind, smoke, fatigue and moments of uncertainty. Do not turn every scene into gunfire or explosions. Alternate danger with quiet observation, waiting, gear checks, breathing and short recovery moments. Tell the story visually with no spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human audio is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion. Use layered audio depth: foreground breathing and equipment, mid-ground surf and movement, background battlefield activity that naturally rises and falls.

scenes.title: Inside the Landing Craft
scenes.description: POV inside a crowded landing craft approaching Omaha before dawn, physically confined and soaked by spray.
scenes.actionDescription: Gloved hands tighten around the rifle as the landing craft rises and drops in rough water; knees absorb each impact while wet sleeves stick to the wrists.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view inside a WWII landing craft, wet steel ramp ahead, U.S. infantry packed shoulder to shoulder, beads of seawater on metal, soaked webbing, gray dawn, sea spray, condensation and historically plausible gear, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: First-person handheld camera sways with the landing craft as soldiers brace silently. Movement has body weight rather than action-camera smoothness. Audio foreground: slow nervous breathing, wet webbing creak, rifle sling and metal buckle taps. Mid-ground: diesel engine, hull vibration, seawater striking steel. Background: distant naval guns muffled by wind. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Ramp Down
scenes.description: The ramp drops and the beach appears through smoke and surf.
scenes.actionDescription: The ramp falls and the POV soldier steps into waist-deep surf, momentarily losing balance under the weight of wet equipment.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over a dropped landing craft ramp toward gray Omaha Beach, cold surf, steel obstacles, smoke, scattered troops moving forward, water droplets on viewpoint, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Ramp drops once; camera lunges forward into water and stumbles half a step before recovering. Audio: sudden ramp crash, cold surf, splashing, soaked fabric, heavy breathing, distant artillery. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Through the Surf
scenes.description: The soldier pushes through water toward the shingle.
scenes.actionDescription: POV wades forward while keeping the rifle above the water, each step slowed by the pull of surf and soaked gear.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet sleeves and rifle above churning gray surf, water streaming off gloves, steel beach obstacles ahead, smoke and bluffs beyond, troops dispersed across beach.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward wading POV with uneven body movement. Audio foreground: labored breathing, water sloshing inside clothing, gear straps creaking. Mid-ground: surf and scattered footsteps. Background: occasional distant ricochets and artillery thumps rather than continuous gunfire. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Obstacle Cover
scenes.description: The soldier reaches a steel obstacle and crouches briefly.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV drops behind one wet steel obstacle, steadies a shaking hand against cold metal, then looks toward the upper beach.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crouched behind a wet steel beach obstacle, water running over rusted metal, sand and foam in foreground, shingle bank and bluffs ahead, smoke drifting in layers, historically grounded.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops low behind one obstacle, stays still for a breath, then tilts once toward the bluffs. Audio: close surf, wind around steel, hand scraping wet metal, breathing; only intermittent distant machine-gun bursts. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Eight Seconds of Breath
scenes.description: A deliberate quiet recovery beat behind the shingle; nothing dramatic happens for several seconds.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stays low, rests one muddy hand on the rifle stock and simply breathes while seawater drips from the sleeve onto stones.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view from low cover behind Omaha shingle bank, muddy wet glove resting on an M1 rifle, droplets falling from cuff onto dark pebbles, beach blurred behind through smoke, subtle hand tremor, no active firing in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still first-person shot. No firing nearby and no explosion. Let the scene breathe. Foreground audio: exhausted breathing, water dripping from clothing, tiny stones shifting under elbow, faint rifle sling creak. Mid-ground: surf softened by the bank. Background: battle almost distant and muffled. No music for this scene. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Find the Squad
scenes.description: Scattered soldiers regroup behind cover using gestures instead of words.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV soldier turns toward a small group forming beside the bluff and notices one soldier signaling toward a draw.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of several U.S. infantrymen crouched behind shingle and rubble, wet uniforms darkened by seawater, one soldier pointing toward a draw in the bluff, smoke and sea behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow pan from beach cover to the regrouping squad. Soldiers communicate only with hand signals. Audio foreground: breathing and wet gear. Mid-ground: boots on stones. Background: wind, surf and irregular artillery. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Engineer Gap
scenes.description: Engineers work on a passage through beach obstacles and wire.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV watches an engineer inspect the disturbed ground, then signal a usable route forward.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view at base of Omaha bluff, engineer beside marked wire gap and disturbed wet sand, hands dusty and wet, squad waiting in cover, no explosion in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera holds on engineer's hands and boots, then rises to one hand signal. Audio: wire lightly rattling in wind, boot scrape, fabric, breathing, distant blasts. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Move to the Bluff
scenes.description: The squad runs across a short exposed section to the bluff base.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV makes one short dash from cover to the base of the bluff, boots slipping once on wet sand before regaining footing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint toward grassy bluff base, boots and rifle entering frame, wet sand, smoke drifting across upper beach, squadmates ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single forward sprint ending in hard stop at bluff cover. Camera bob is heavy and human, not exaggerated. Audio: boots, wet sand, gear bounce, hard breathing, distant fire. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Climb
scenes.description: The group begins climbing a rough route up the bluff.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands grab cold earth, wet roots and grass while climbing behind another soldier.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands smeared with damp soil climbing a steep grassy Normandy bluff, bent grass, exposed roots, boots of a squadmate above, beach far below partially visible, no graphic combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Upward first-person climb with one continuous camera rise and brief slips. Audio foreground: breathing, glove against dirt, roots snapping, loose soil. Background battle becomes more distant with elevation. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Above the Beach
scenes.description: The POV reaches the top and takes a quiet look back before moving on.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pulls onto the high ground, remains still for two breaths, then turns once toward the beach below.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view from top of Normandy bluff looking down toward Omaha Beach through layered smoke, landing craft offshore, tiny figures moving below, wet muddy gloves at edge of frame, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera rises over edge, stays almost still, then performs one slow look back. No nearby firing. Audio: strong wind on bluff, far surf, very distant artillery, exhausted breathing and fabric flutter. No music. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Hedgerow
scenes.description: The squad moves into the first hedgerow beyond the bluff.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV pushes through one opening in a dense hedgerow, leaves brushing wet sleeves and helmet.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person approach to thick Normandy hedgerow and narrow farm lane, dew on leaves, tangled branches, squadmate signaling caution, wet vegetation, gray morning.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move through one hedgerow gap. Audio foreground: leaves scraping helmet and web gear, boots in soft earth, breathing. Background: battle now distant; a bird briefly audible. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Farm Lane
scenes.description: The soldiers cross a narrow farm lane toward cover, entering an unexpectedly ordinary rural space.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV crosses the lane and settles behind a stone wall, noticing wet grass and an abandoned farm gate.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crossing a narrow Normandy lane toward low mossy stone wall and orchard, wet grass, wooden gate, scattered squadmates, cool gray morning light, historically plausible rural landscape.
scenes.videoPrompt: One lateral-forward camera move across lane ending behind wall. Audio: boots on gravel, leather creak, wind in leaves, birds briefly audible, very distant artillery. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: First Foothold
scenes.description: The squad pauses in an orchard above the beachhead.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV reloads slowly while water and sand fall from the gear, then rests the rifle against the stone wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands loading ammunition in a small Normandy orchard, scratched receiver, damp sleeves, tiny bits of sand on glove seams, squad nearby, smoke faintly visible beyond hedgerow.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static first-person shot with one careful reload action. Audio foreground: magazine and bolt sounds, fabric, breathing. Mid-ground: leaves and boots. Background: distant guns only. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Beach Behind Us
scenes.description: A reflective quiet scene showing the scale and distance of the beach already crossed.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a narrow gap in the hedgerow and simply watches the distant coast for several seconds.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person distant view back toward Omaha from inland high ground, leaves framing the view, landing craft offshore, movement on beach reduced to tiny shapes, smoke thinning, damp glove resting on stone wall, respectful documentary tone.
scenes.videoPrompt: Very slow pan through hedgerow gap toward distant beach, then hold. No nearby action. Audio: wind through leaves, one bird, faint far surf, occasional distant artillery, slow tired breathing. No music. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Inland
scenes.description: The squad disappears down a farm track as the battle continues elsewhere.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad down one narrow farm track away from the coast at a tired walking pace.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view following a small U.S. infantry squad down a Normandy farm track between dense wet hedgerows, boot prints in soft earth, early morning light, battle haze behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear-follow first-person movement down farm track at a believable fatigued pace. Audio: boots in damp soil, leaves brushing gear, distant battle fading behind, tired breathing. End without victory celebration. No speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous fictional composite soldier used only as the viewer's first-person perspective; historically plausible 1944 U.S. infantry uniform and equipment; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: M1941/M1943-compatible field gear, M1 helmet, web equipment, wet uniform, M1 rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep sleeves, gloves, rifle, helmet shadow and web gear consistent. Wetness, mud, sand and fatigue must accumulate naturally and not reset between scenes. Avoid showing a clear face unless absolutely necessary.

atmosphereAssets.title: Omaha Surf Line
atmosphereAssets.description: Gray rough surf, cold water, landing craft, wet steel beach obstacles, salt spray, smoke layers and steep bluffs beyond.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: flat overcast dawn with low visibility

atmosphereAssets.title: Omaha Beach and Bluff Base
atmosphereAssets.description: Wide wet tidal beach, shingle bank, wire, obstacles, cold wind, smoke that varies in density, bluff base and narrow draws; sound changes noticeably behind cover.

atmosphereAssets.title: Normandy Inland Hedgerows
atmosphereAssets.description: Dense dew-covered hedgerows, narrow damp farm lanes, mossy stone walls, small orchards, wet vegetation, ordinary rural sounds and battlefield noise fading with distance.
